Method.name: ProcessError
Method.Implementation:
set errObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.DataStructure.InterfaceErrorEvent).%New() set errObj.MessageId = proc.%request.GetValueAt("MSH:7") // .%Id() $$$TRACE("errObj.MessageId: " _ errObj.MessageId) set errObj.ErrorCode = retCode set errObj.InterfaceName = proc.%ConfigName set errObj.SourceMessage = proc.%request.RawContent
set errObj.TimeStamp = $$$timeLocal // $ZDATETIME($ZTIMESTAMP,3,,9) set errObj.StoredProcParamsCollection = storedProcParamsCollection $$$TRACE("storedProcParamsCollection #: " _ storedProcParamsCollection.MyProp.Count())
set tSC = proc.SendRequestAsync(target, errObj) if $$$ISERR(tSC) { $$$LOGERROR("Failed to call: " _ target _", stat: " _ tSC) return tSC } else { $$$LOGINFO("Sent error to: " _ target) } return $$$OK
